scientific_integrity: Symbolic derivation from Poisson Fourier moments, concavity and endpoint expansions; standard-library finite diagnostics are supplementary and not proof. Best-knowledge originality with historical priority risk.
scientific_limitations: Only fixed n>=5, fixed common radius 0<r<1, and local angular perturbations. The number, uniqueness and locations of modal transitions are not classified; no global or radial optimality claim. Independent validation has not occurred.
title: Strict angular stability and universal soft-mode reversal for equiradial finite Blaschke products
